biography: Tommy, representing Espoo Ringside Golf, has become a consistent presence within the competitive landscape of the Hector Trophée. Over the course of the tournament's history, he has graced the fairways on three separate occasions, showcasing his dedication to this esteemed annual event.

Throughout his participation, Tommy has exhibited a determined approach to the game. While he has yet to etch his name onto either the coveted Hector Trophée for the winning pair or claim the individual Victor Trophy, his competitive spirit remains undimmed. Known for his unflappable temperament and a steady, rhythmic swing, Tommy is a player who meticulously dissects each shot, a testament to his thoughtful and analytical style of play.

As the Hector Trophée 2026 draws near, it has been confirmed that Tommy will not be taking to the course this year. Despite this hiatus, his previous appearances underscore his commitment to the tournament, and the golf community will undoubtedly await his return to competitive Hector events in future editions.
